structured.approach: I loaded the frontend-steps skill for FE-05 and read task.code and feat.stories. I used CodeGraph to read the source of renderOverdueRisk and its helpers, and I read ci.mjs. CodeGraph showed that the helpers had no covering tests, and task.code listed the uncovered lines as 26-28 33-39 42-44 50-61. I added 13 node:test cases to tests/portal.test.js after the 2 existing tests, which I did not change. There is one test for each of AC-07.1 to AC-07.10, plus the three TypeError coverage cases that task.code section 6 hands over. All test data is synthetic SYN-INV rows. I ran `node ci.mjs` until it passed, then ran `codegraph sync` and `codegraph affected`. Last, I wrote task.unit_tests with a traceability table from each test to its acceptance criterion. Note: I piped the CI JSON through a node one-liner only to summarise it. The CI command itself was `node ci.mjs`.

claims.text: Before FE-05, CI reported coverage 60.32 with 2 tests run, and lines 26-28 33-39 42-44 50-61 of src/ap_portal/index.js were uncovered.
After the new tests, node ci.mjs reports compile true, 15 tests run, 0 failures, 0 errors, coverage 100, no static issues and passed true, which meets the gate of coverage >= 90.
Only tests/portal.test.js was changed in this step. The 2 existing tests ('formats amounts with two decimals' and 'renders every bucket in order') are unchanged and still pass.
Each of the acceptance criteria AC-07.1 to AC-07.10 of STORY-07 has at least one test, named with the criterion ID.

The amount tests check that two-decimal strings, including one longer than a JS Number can hold, are shown unchanged, and that '980.5' is padded to '980.50'. This follows the Decimal-never-float decision D-2026-044.

Tests cover the TypeError paths handed over by FE-04: non-array rows, non-integer days, and amounts with an exponent, a thousands separator or three decimals. Each asserts the exact error message in the code.
codegraph affected for tests/portal.test.js and src/ap_portal/index.js reports 1 affected test file, tests/portal.test.js.

open_questions: Q-1 (non-blocking, Developer): FE-05 does not receive feat.design B4.5 or the TRD test definitions T-12 to T-16, so the tests trace to AC-07.1 to AC-07.10 only. Should the evaluator also check them against B4.5?
Q-2 (non-blocking, Developer; carried from task.code Q-1): which step moves VERSION in index.js and package.json together (TK-07.5) before FE-06?
Q-3 (non-blocking, Architect; carried from task.code Q-2): should a missing or non-string id or vendor throw TypeError? No test pins the current String(value) behaviour.
structured.summary: I added 13 unit tests for renderOverdueRisk (STORY-07) to tests/portal.test.js. They cover AC-07.1 to AC-07.10 and the TypeError paths for rows, days and amount. `node ci.mjs` passes: 15 tests, 0 failures and 100% line, branch and function coverage of src/ap_portal/index.js, against a gate of 90% (coverage was 60.32 before). The traceability, CI output and open questions are written to outputs/FEAT-ZD-48600/task.unit_tests.md. Nothing is committed.
